name: app-orange-egypt-mobile-site-in-hand-on-black
title: Orange Egypt mobile redesign: a hand holding a phone beside the orange square logo on black
whatItIs: A dark cover with a blurred person holding a phone showing the Orange Egypt Arabic mobile site (hero banner, services cards), the orange square logo and 'Orange Egypt' in white on the left.
whatItMeans: Real and brand-true; the in-hand photo and the orange square make it feel native to the brand.
techniques: Use a real hand-held phone photo.
Place the brand's logo square as the only colour.
Blur the person so the screen leads.

vocabulary.definition: A photo of a device held in a hand.
A logo presented as a solid colour block.
